Hormesis in lettuce plants

Source: R/data.R
lettuce.Rd

The shoot biomass of lettuce (Lactuca sativa) plants after 21 days in a nutrient solution with isobutyl alcohol. Low concentrations stimulate the growth (hormesis).

Usage

lettuce

Format

A data frame with 14 rows and 2 variables:

conc

concentration of isobutyl alcohol (mg/l)

weight

shoot biomass (g)

Source

van Ewijk, P. H. and Hoekstra, J. A. (1993) Calculation of the EC50 and its confidence interval when subtoxic stimulus is present. Ecotoxicology and Environmental Safety, 25, 25–32; from the package drcData.

References

van Ewijk, P. H. and Hoekstra, J. A. (1994) Curvature measures and confidence intervals for the linear logistic model. Applied Statistics, 43, 477–487.

Examples

hmod <- drmTMB(weight ~ conc, data = lettuce, model = "braincousens")
peak(hmod)
#> Peak of the hormesis curves, dose and response:
#> 
#>              Estimate Std.Error
#> dose:lf1         0.72    0.2670
#> response:lf1     1.20    0.0694
